title: A verbose immutable POJO with hand-written equals/hashCode + an instanceof cast is a prime Java 21 record + pattern-switch candidate
notes: Dimensions is an immutable data carrier whose whole boilerplate (constructor, getters, equals, hashCode) collapses to `record Dimensions(int width, int height)` plus the area() method. Edge case: a record's generated equals/hashCode cover ALL components, which matches the hand-written version here — but if the hand-written equals had omitted a field, the record would NOT be behaviourally identical, so it must be verified. The instanceof-cast can also become pattern matching.
